critique_summary: The platform is in a state of catastrophic failure with 15/16 scheduler jobs failing persistently for over 12 hours. Equity data is severely corrupted, showing an impossible 152% overnight jump (196k to 496k) that contradicts the -0.15% performance report, while conviction scores are recorded at 5.00, violating the 0-1 range constraint.
critique_flags: Impossible PnL jump: Equity increased 152% between 2026-04-01T09:26 and 2026-04-02T01:29 despite a -0.15% performance log.
Data Anomaly: Conviction scores (5.00) are outside the defined 0-1 range.
System Degradation: Repeated failure of 15/16 scheduler jobs (never_run/analysis_failed) across 50+ log entries.
Stale Data: Kraken bot heartbeat is 39309s old (>10 hours), indicating total loss of crypto execution control.
Stale Equity Curve: Gap of >15 hours in equity reporting during active market cycles.
Duplicate Data: Identical equity rows detected at 2026-04-02T05:59:02.
